info.title: Autodesk Fusion Manage PLM API (community reference)
info.summary: Path-and-method spec generated from the Fusion Manage PLM Docs site.
info.description:
Unofficial, community-maintained. Generated from the documented endpoints at
https://autogusx.github.io/fusion-manage-plm-docs.

**Scope:** paths, methods, and path/query parameters only. Request and response
bodies are documented as worked examples in prose on the linked pages rather than
as formal schemas — they are deliberately not invented here. Use each operation's
`externalDocs` link for the real payload shapes, confirmed status codes, and caveats.

**Auth:** all endpoints take an OAuth2 bearer token plus an `x-tenant` header.

license.name: Community reference — not an Autodesk product

servers.description: Fusion Manage tenant. Both v1 and v3 live on this host.

tags.name: Classifications
tags.description: The classification tree — v2 CRUD, plus a v3 sibling endpoint for reading a class's fields, confirmed live and from Autodesk's official Postman collection.

tags.name: Parts and Classifications
tags.description: Link a workspace to its root classifications and look up a workspace's classification-bound "part" record.

tags.name: Property Instances
tags.description: Read classification-bound property values and their display metadata, and resolve classification-driven picklist lookup values.

tags.name: Admin Impersonation
tags.description: The separate APS 2-legged client-credentials flow used to act as another user for admin operations, via the X-User-Id header.

tags.name: Attachments
tags.description: The full attachment lifecycle — list, upload (3-step S3 flow), check-in/check-out, version history, and delete — from a detailed Word add-in spec and Autodesk's official Postman collection.

tags.name: BOM
tags.description: BOM views, read/flatten/where-used, and add/update/remove rows on v3 — confirmed shapes from Autodesk's official Postman collection.

tags.name: Fusion Components (Manufacturing GraphQL)
tags.description: A separate GraphQL API bridging Fusion Manage PLM items to Fusion 360 CAD design data and manufacturing properties — not part of the core PLM REST surface.

tags.name: Items
tags.description: Create, update, and archive items on v3 — confirmed request shapes, link-scoping rules, and the PUT/PATCH asymmetry, verified live against a real tenant.

tags.name: Relationships and Affected Items
tags.description: Change-order affected items (Managed Items tab) and item-to-item relationships, via numbered workspace views — with the views/2 vs views/11 direction conclusively resolved.

tags.name: Reports, Dashboards, Bookmarks, and Recently-Viewed
tags.description: Retrieve saved reports, dashboard charts, bookmarks, and recently-viewed items — full endpoint list from a production Chrome extension client.

tags.name: Scripts
tags.description: List and retrieve tenant custom scripts, and run a script against an item — a 100% v3 subsystem.

tags.name: Search
tags.description: The two distinct search subsystems — the v3 query-grammar search-results endpoint and the v1 structured searchDefinition body — with confirmed live examples.

tags.name: Suppliers
tags.description: Approved Manufacturer/Supplier (AML) list and quotes for an item, via the fixed views/8 pattern.

tags.name: Users, Groups, and Roles
tags.description: User, group, and role management on v3 — confirmed live and cross-checked against Autodesk's official Postman collection, including a corrected v3-roles claim.

tags.name: Views, Fields, Tableaus, Grid/Project Tabs, and Picklists
tags.description: Workspace field/view discovery, tableau CRUD, grid and project tab rows, and picklist lookups — confirmed from Autodesk's official Postman collection.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Register callbacks for item/workflow events — a separate APS Webhooks API, not a Fusion Manage endpoint, discovered via Autodesk's official Postman collection.

tags.name: Workflow
tags.description: Workspace-level and item-level workflow states/transitions/history on v3 — confirmed from Autodesk's official Postman collection. Distinct from lifecycle transitions.

tags.name: Workspaces
tags.description: List and retrieve workspaces and their sub-resources — confirmed from Autodesk's official Postman collection, with real example data.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: How to obtain and use a Fusion Manage bearer token — the session-cookie exchange, APS OAuth flows, and the legacy localStorage fallback.

tags.name: Errors
tags.description: The standard Fusion Manage error envelope, the HTTP status code table, and which errors are actually recoverable rather than fatal.

tags.name: Pagination
tags.description: The page/size, offset/limit, and combined limit/offset/page conventions used across different Fusion Manage list endpoints.

tags.name: Troubleshooting
tags.description: Reverse index from the error or status code you actually got to what it really means and how to fix it — every entry observed against a live tenant.

tags.name: API Versions: v1, v2, and v3
tags.description: What v1, v2, and v3 actually mean in Fusion Manage, which one to use for which operation, and the known discrepancies between documentation and working code.

tags.name: Admin and Config
tags.description: Common admin tasks — impersonating a user, looking up a workspace by its stable name, auditing config changes, and managing group access.

tags.name: Authentication Quickstart
tags.description: Get a bearer token and make your first authenticated Fusion Manage API call — the fastest path for each client type.

tags.name: Change Orders and Workflow
tags.description: A Change Order lifecycle walkthrough — finding affected items, checking status, and performing a workflow transition.

tags.name: Scripting
tags.description: Enumerate a workspace's or tenant's custom scripts and pull their source.

tags.name: Working with BOM
tags.description: Read a BOM, add/update/remove a line, and run a where-used query.

tags.name: Working with Items
tags.description: Create, update, and archive an item end to end, using the confirmed v3 shapes and link-scoping rules.

tags.name: Fusion Manage PLM Docs
tags.description: Human- and AI-readable reference for the Autodesk Fusion Manage PLM API (v2 and v3) — concepts, endpoint reference, and task-oriented guides.

tags.name: Recipe: bulk-create items from a spreadsheet
tags.description: Map columns to real field IDs, validate before you write, and create items in a loop that fails safely partway through.

tags.name: Recipe: clone an assembly with its BOM
tags.description: There is no clone endpoint — build one from item create plus BOM rows, with the field-inclusion rules that decide whether it succeeds.

tags.name: Recipe: release an item through a change order
tags.description: The canonical PLM flow end to end — find the change order, add the affected item, drive the workflow, and confirm the release actually happened.
